style_preamble: Match the attached reference images exactly: the same illustrated storybook look, the same soft dark outline around every shape, the same matte painted shading with no gloss, the same warm muted daylight palette lit from the upper left, and the same high three-quarter viewing angle the reference street is drawn from, looking down on the figure from above and slightly to one side. Draw one person only, alone, upright and centred, with generous empty margin on every side. No ground, no paving, no grass, no shadow, no scenery, no props beyond what the person is wearing or carrying, and no background of any kind: the entire background must be fully transparent. The cast's skin and hair stay inside the range broadly spanning fair European through East Asian complexions, with hair in black, brown, auburn, blond, grey or silver. This is a constraint on the default World Pack's cast only and is recorded as ARC-22; it is not a statement about who a MineWorld world may contain, and a World Pack ships its own cast with no reference to it.
